title: Refuse a recursive delete of a lane, the shared .worktrees directory or an ancestor while it holds uncommitted or ignored files or an active claim; inside a lane, refuse only for tracked edits and untracked unignored files under the target, so ignored caches delete freely.
verification: Candidate regression tests run the engine guard against real lanes: ignored .pytest_cache and __pycache__ deletes beside an untracked root file, an in-lane directory with a tracked edit, an untracked unignored file, a lane root, and an ancestor of a claimed lane; no deployed proof yet.
